analysis.title: GE Vernova (GEV): Standout Power quarter, raising estimates
key_insights: 3Q26 segment EBITDA was $2,108mn, +15% vs GS ($1,827mn) and +16% vs consensus ($1,810mn), driven largely by a beat in Power.
Power segment EBITDA was ~$1.3bn at a 21.4% margin vs GS 18.4% and consensus 18.1%, +800bps organically y/y, despite 3Q historically being the lightest Services quarter.
3Q26 was the first quarter at the ~5GW quarterly gas equipment shipment run-rate, with better-priced equipment flowing through the P&L.
Management said 2H26 is an appropriate starting point for 2027 Power margins, with factory productivity also contributing.
Power orders were $21.8bn, +178% organically. Gas Power backlog plus slot reservation agreements (SRAs) rose from 116GW to 122GW q/q.
Management now expects at least 130GW under contract by YE26, implying 4Q orders plus SRAs of more than 11GW added in 3Q.
Management expects FY26 gas equipment orders $/kW to be about 50% above FY25 orders. GS sees the quality and durability of Power margins as the key takeaway from the call.
Power Services orders are +17% YTD. Management suggested its prior $22bn Power Services revenue target for 2035 is likely conservative.
GEV announced the acquisition of Trench Group, which management called complementary, increasing addressable market and helping scale the HV portfolio in a margin-accretive way.
GS raises FY27-FY28 EBITDA estimates by 8-9%, mainly on stronger Power margins, and keeps its Buy rating.
GS lowers its 12-month price target to $1,176 from $1,224 on a lower Q5-Q8 EBITDA multiple of 22.0x (prior 27.0x), reflecting a de-rating in the AI/data center space.

market_movers.rationale: Buy reiterated after a Power-led beat and higher EBITDA estimates. Price target cut from $1,224 to $1,176 on a lower target multiple (22.0x vs 27.0x) reflecting an AI/data center de-rating. Implies 33.9% upside from $878.03.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 segment EBITDA reported at $2,108mn vs GS estimate $1,827mn and FactSet consensus $1,810mn.
3Q26 total organic growth +18% reported vs GS estimate +11.3%. By segment, reported vs GS estimate: Power +25% (GS +19%), Wind +3% (GS -13.7%), Electrification +16% (GS +22.8%).
Power segment 3Q26 margin 21.4% reported vs GS estimate 18.4% and consensus 18.1%.
GEV raised its FY26 revenue guide to $46.5-$47.5bn from $45.5-$46.5bn, and its adj. EBITDA margin guide to 13.5%-14.5% from 12-14%.
FY26 FCF guidance raised to $16-$17bn from $11.5-$12.5bn.
GS estimates: FY26/FY27/FY28 EBITDA $6,850mn/$11,280mn/$14,800mn (from $6,430mn/$10,340mn/$13,650mn). FY26E EPS $15.05, FY27E $28.00, FY28E $37.50 (GS forecasts).
risk_factors: Slower growth due to regulatory or geopolitical changes.
Project delays from supply chain disruptions.
